name: Pegassi Tempesta
description: An aerodynamic masterpiece of Italian engineering. Built for speed, precision cornering, and showing off on Vice Beach.

name: Grotti Cheetah Classic
description: Retro styling meets modern performance. A direct throwback to 1980s Vice City luxury and high-speed pursuits.

name: Bravado Banshee
description: An icon of raw American muscle disguised as a sports car. Extremely fast but prone to wild oversteer.

name: Vapid Dominator ASP
description: Supercharged torque in a heavy frame. Sounds like a thunderstorm and tears up the asphalt in straight-line drags.

name: Karin Sultan RS
description: All-wheel-drive rally-bred tuner classic. Extremely agile on dirt roads and boasts a four-door chassis optimized for getaways.

name: Declasse Granger 3600LX
description: A heavy-duty tactical SUV designed for maximum safety. Features bullet-resistant glass and accommodates up to eight crew members.

name: Pfister Comet S2
description: The peak of German rear-engine design. Impeccable stability at high speeds and a beautiful sleek silhouette.

name: Albany Emperor
description: A long, heavy lowrider classic. Rides incredibly smooth and is the ultimate choice for a leisurely cruise down the neon strip.
